text: Why did the car apply for a job? Because it wanted to quit being exhausted!
What do you call a Ford Fiesta that ran out of gas? A Ford Siesta!
Why do cars hate winter? Because they get tire-d of the cold!
What kind of car does an electrician drive? A Volts-wagen!
Why did the traffic light turn red? It had to change in front of all those people!
What do you call a car that's been in a freezer? A chili-mobile!
Why did the car break up with the motorcycle? It was two-tired of the relationship!
What do you call a lazy engine? A motor-vation problem!
Why don't cars ever get lost? Because they always follow the car-navi!
What did the steering wheel say to the driver? You drive me around the bend!
Why did the mechanic sleep under the car? Because he wanted to get up oily in the morning!
What do you call a car that can sing? A Hyundai Sonata!
How does a car greet its owner? It gives a little honk!
Why was the car so good at school? Because it had a lot of drive!
What happened when the frog's car broke down? It got toad away!
